briefdescription.para: Now that the operands for this expression tree are linearized and optimized, emit them in-order.

inbodydescription.para: NodesToRewrite - Nodes from the original expression available for writing the new expression into.

NotRewritable - The operands being written will be the leaves of the new expression and must not be used as inner nodes (via NodesToRewrite) by mistake. Inner nodes are always reassociable, and usually leaves are not (if they were they would have been incorporated into the expression and so would not be leaves), so most of the time there is no danger of this. But in rare cases a leaf may become reassociable if an optimization kills uses of it, or it may momentarily become reassociable during rewriting (below) due it being removed as an operand of one of its uses. Ensure that misuse of leaf nodes as inner nodes cannot occur by remembering all of the future leaves and refusing to reuse any of them as inner nodes.

detaileddescription.para: This optimizes based on identities. If it can be reduced to a single Value, it is returned, otherwise the Ops list is mutated as necessary.

briefdescription.para: Build a minimal multiplication DAG for (a^x)*(b^y)*(c^z)*...

detaileddescription.para: Given a vector of values raised to various powers, where no two values are equal and the powers are sorted in decreasing order, compute the minimal DAG of multiplies to compute the final product, and return that product value.

briefdescription.para: If V is an expression tree that is a multiplication sequence, and if this sequence contains a multiply by Factor, remove Factor from the tree and return the new tree.
Zap the given instruction, adding interesting operands to the work list.

detaileddescription.para: Note that erasing instructions is not allowed.

briefdescription.para: Given an fadd/fsub with an operand that is a one-use instruction (the fadd/fsub), try to change negative floating-point constants into positive constants to increase potential for reassociation and CSE.

Canonicalize expressions that contain a negative floating-point constant of the following form: OtherOp + (subtree) -> OtherOp {+/-} (canonical subtree) (subtree) + OtherOp -> OtherOp {+/-} (canonical subtree) OtherOp - (subtree) -> OtherOp {+/-} (canonical subtree)

detaileddescription.para: The fadd/fsub opcode may be switched to allow folding a negation into the input instruction.
